Strategy-minded builder. I turn user insight into products, launches and operations that scale.

Hi, I'm Sonu. I'm a product manager who likes starting with the customer conversation and ending with a shipped feature and a number that moved.

I've worked across fintech, biotech and Web3, in India and the U.S. My background is unusual for a PM: a law degree, an MBA, and a STEM master's in global management from ASU's Thunderbird School of Global Management. That mix taught me to read the rules, the numbers and the people before writing a single spec.

AI · GTM · Execution MGM · MBA · Law

Now: looking for my next product role, and building side projects, starting with the trivia game on this page.

Beyond the job

Thunderbird, on and off the stage

Clubs, competitions and community from my time at Thunderbird. Tap any photo to see it larger.

Second prize

AI Case Series Hackathon

My team won second prize at the AI Case Series Hackathon during the 3rd Annual Thunderbird AI Conference, themed "Future of Work, Rewritten by AI."

We had a few hours to take a business case, build an AI-driven solution and pitch it to judges.

GCL in Utah with Paterna Biosciences

My GCL project took me to Salt Lake City to work with Paterna Biosciences on their Mexico launch. We interviewed patients, physicians and clinical teams, then turned what we heard into a go-to-market roadmap with the leadership team.

Between meetings, the team hiked above the city.

AI Club at Thunderbird

I was part of the AI Club at Thunderbird, helping classmates get hands-on with AI tools for business through events, workshops and club fairs.

Global Sounds

Global Sounds is Thunderbird's music club, and it's where my love of music went from the playlist to the stage. We brought students from dozens of countries together through performances and music nights.

Student Government

I served in Thunderbird's student government, helping plan events and represent a student body from all over the world.

35th Annual Ambassadors Ball

Thunderbird invited me to the 35th Annual Ambassadors Ball, hosted by the Diplomatic Corps of Arizona at the Arizona Biltmore. It was a truly meaningful night, and I'm grateful I got to be part of it.

Side projects

What I'm building

Live · Play below

Trivia Board

A click-to-play trivia game: five categories, 25 questions and a running score. Pick a tile, answer out loud, reveal the answer and score yourself.

Harder questions are worth more, and a wrong answer costs you the tile's points, so every pick is a small risk decision.

Game designJavaScriptAI-assisted build
In progress

Job Tracker

I'm job searching, so I'm building the tool I wish I had. It tracks every application from saved to offer, with deadlines, follow-ups and contacts in one place.

It also flags which companies sponsor visas, a filter most job boards don't handle well.

How I work

How I use AI

Automating the busywork

At SuperWorld I used AI-powered tools to assign tasks, track progress and automate reporting, so the team spent time on decisions instead of spreadsheets.

Finding the customer in the data

At Tata Capital I used AI-assisted segmentation on CRM data to build personas and spot cross-sell opportunities.

Writing faster, thinking harder

I use AI to draft PRDs, research competitors and pressure-test specs, then spend my own time on judgment and trade-offs.

Building without waiting

My side projects are built with AI coding assistants, so I can go from idea to working prototype on my own. It also helped my team place second at the AI Case Series Hackathon.
